blocks.text: Computing systems hamari zindagi ke har pehlu mein shamil hain, is liye un ka qanooni aur akhlaqi pehlu ahem hai. Yeh chapter terms of use, privacy aur security ke khatre, digital divide, maloomat ka zimmedarana istemal, muashre par computing ka asar, aur digital citizenship batata hai. Qanooni masail mein data ka tahaffuz, intellectual property aur qawaneen ki pabandi, aur akhlaqi masail mein privacy, insaf aur technology ke wasee asraat shamil hain.

blocks.title: Terms of Use
blocks.text: Terms of Use, jinhein Terms and Conditions ya Terms of Service bhi kehte hain, provider (website, app ya software company) ke banaye qanooni muahide hain jinhein user ko qabool karna hota hai. Yeh batate hain ke service kaise istemal ho sakti hai aur munsifana, shaffaf rishta chahte hain jis mein dono fareeq apne huqooq aur faraiz jaanein.

Gmail par sign up karne ka matlab Google ki un shiqon par raza hai ke account kaise istemal ho, kya share nahi ho sakta aur zaati data kaise sambhala jata hai. Daraz jaisa Pakistani shopping platform adaigi ke tareeqon, wapsi aur delivery ki shiqein rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Terms of use kaun banata hai aur kaun qabool karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Service provider banata hai; service istemal karne ke liye user ko qabool karna parta hai.

items: Terms of use: service ke provider ke qanooni qawaid jin par user raza deta hai (Gmail, Daraz).
